mentions.name: Traffic Bean
mentions.description: This project promotes an alternative junction design, the 'traffic bean', for fixing broken real-world traffic intersections. The design can be implemented with nothing more than traffic cones (later upgradeable to permanent objects) to enable continuous flow, safety, and infrastructure that stays usable at high-throughput times, without expensive traffic signals or red/green/yellow light cycles, and is being brought to American municipalities.
mentions.problem: Broken junctions around the author, and traffic infrastructure that becomes completely unusable at high-throughput times.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm literally trying to fix broken junctions around me.

It's at the same time laughably easy, and wildly complicated.

I'm calling the alternative, correct junction a 'traffic bean':

https://josh.works/traffic-bean
